-Note card SHALL have at least one incoming link; every card SHALL be reachable
from the Mission; and all links[].target values SHALL reference an existing card
Aurora tooling and documentation SHALL use a canonical registry of relationship

Each Aurora model SHALL start with exactly one Mission card that serves as the r
oot of the directed graph. The Mission card SHALL only have outgoing links and S
HALL provide a consistent starting point for traversal and view generation.
All Aurora card files SHALL include a $schema field referencing the applicable A
urora schema using a relative path from the card file to the Model Home schema f
Aurora card files SHALL be stored as strict JSON (RFC 8259) using the .jsjson ex
tension: double quotes, no comments, no trailing commas, UTF-8 encoding, and exa
Aurora card and relationship labels SHALL be treated as descriptive metadata; th
e meaning of the architecture SHALL be derived from the model’s invariant rules
and the current view’s inclusion/projection of card types and links.
Boundary cards SHALL be used to group related cards for rendering and navigation
; they may have a subtype such as End to limit recursion. Note cards SHALL be us
ed only as annotative leaves (incoming links only) and SHALL NOT introduce new s
Machine and Human Readable Source of Truth
Ensure Aurora models remain directly interpretable by expert practitioners while
staying friendly to machine parsing, tooling, and agent consumption.
Provide a stable, shared vocabulary for cards, relationship verbs, and views so
validation and rendering can be deterministic and portable across tools.
A rigorous, MBSE-class architectural modeling framework designed for equal reada
bility by human engineers, machine learning ("AI") agents, and computer programs
. It provides a lightweight but complete representational schema that captures r
equirements, behavior, structure, interfaces, constraints, and traceability in a
single, coherent model. The objective is a common architectural language that s
upports automated reasoning, validation, and lifecycle tooling while remaining d
Because it is designed to be rea
dable by machine agents as well as humans, Aurora artifacts can be generated by
machine learning models, consumed by coding agents, and used to automatically ge
Views SHALL be treated as projections of a single underlying model graph by sele
cting a set of card types (and optional subtypes) and rendering only those cards
and the links between them; views SHALL NOT change the underlying model.
All Aurora links SHALL lead away from the Mission card. Local cycles MAY exist w
ithin bounded subgraphs (for example state machines) as long as no link creates
a path back to the Mission.
All Aurora cards SHALL include an audit_trail with a per-card SemVer version, an
optional SHA256 hash (nullable), and a chronological history of created/edited/
deleted events including editor identity and RFC3339 timestamps.
Enable unambiguous interpretation and automated reasoning by enforcing determini
stic model structure and traversal rules rooted at the Mission card.
Aurora tooling and documentation SHALL use a canonical registry of view definiti
ons that declare which card types are included and what root types anchor each v

nce issued. Card files SHALL be named <id>-<Sanitized_Name>.jsjson, where specia
l characters are stripped and spaces are replaced with underscores. Models SHALL
